text: This report recommends the appointment of an Acting President for the Toronto Parking Authority.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Confirmed its actions in closed session in issuing a confidential instruction to staff. 2. Authorized the public release of the name of the individual identified in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 15, 2018) from the Chair, Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority, once the recommendations are adopted by the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority. (November 26, 2018 - 3:03 p.m.) The following confidential instruction to staff is now public: "1. That the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority appoint Robin Oliphant, identified in Confidential Attachment 1 of the report (November 15, 2018) from the Chair, Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority, to the position of Acting President, effective November 27, 2018."
